## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (98%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Unflagged tier-1 frozen section with Benign-only conformal set [F1], though region 9 (92% risk) and margins need review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 98%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0%, Normal 0% | Strong Benign call; 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (alpha 10%, coverage 90%, n=132) | Single class at 90% guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 98%, OOD 100th percentile, 12/12 tiles, JPEG-3 [F6] | Unflagged, but extreme OOD, degraded |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class (true) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 3/5 Benign (60%), 1 Invasive (77%), 1 InSitu (76%) [F5] | Mixed neighbors; invasive contrast 77% |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical score (-0.53, contrib -0.97) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 2, 4, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical confinement (1.42, contrib -0.49) opposes invasion [F3] · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical stroma (0.12, contrib +0.36) nudges toward invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 1, 11) · ↓ invasive · Elevated text score (1.21, contrib -0.31), caption-inconsistent · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Low score (0.26, contrib -0.20), failed 0/20 spot-check · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (+0.0008 vs random, 95% CI -0.0088–0.0064); minor scores mitoses (0/20), normal lobules (0/20), necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Region 9 (92% risk) harbors focal invasion like neighbor BACH_0138 (77% similar), or regions 2, 4, 8 are DCIS.
- Severity-3 JPEG frozen-section artifacts (100th-percentile OOD) mask malignancy, or medial (99%) and superior (96%) margins are positive [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 9, 0, 1**: Exclude focal invasion in region 9 (92% risk) and regions 0 (28%), 1 (24%).
2. **Regions 2, 4, 8, 3**: Distinguish benign hyperplasia from DCIS (regions 2, 4, 8) and exclude invasion (region 3).
3. **Regions 4, 1, 8, 11**: Inspect medial (99%, region 4) and superior (96%, region 1) margins near threshold.
